body:
maria (sec-eng): heads up — after the RBAC change last night staging saw a 10x jump in audit events. KMS errors and a backlog formed. noticed ~3.2M events in 10m window. :warning:
kevin (infra): ugh. seeing KMS 429s and kms.latency spikes in infra metrics. stack traces show our per-event envelope key fetches are the hot path.
ingest-bot: ALERT: audit-ingest queue depth spike at 2025-10-22T02:12Z - ingest_rate=5200r/s, error_rate=0.8%, kms_429=14%
sasha (eng-sre): can we shut off any noisy RBAC verbose logs temporarily? also we should rate-limit per-tenant and apply priority to admin/audit events. sampling for low-value events for 24h will give breathing room.
ryan (product-sec): important we don't lose any customer-facing audit entries required for compliance. Which events are safe to sample? we need a checklist for retention & required fields.
maria (sec-eng): agreed. initial triage: 1) identify events marked "mandatory_for_compliance" 2) sample rest 3) enable DEK caching so we don't hit KMS per-event 4) add circuit-breaker on ingest pipeline.
kevin (infra): DEK caching is the right short-term move. currently we fetch a new DEK per event: `kms.decrypt(envelope)` for each row. caching per-tenant DEK for 1h reduces calls by ~95%. also we can batch KMS decrypts for older backfill jobs.
sasha (eng-sre): minimal change we can push asap: - feature flag to enable sampling/priority - DEK cache in front of KMS calls - backpressure circuit-breaker to start returning 429 from proxy to upstream (not to drop)
ryan (product-sec): for customer validation we should surface a sampled event stream to customers and a checksum count so they can tell if any required events were sampled. schema compatibility must be preserved.
maria (sec-eng): draft schema diff — we're adding `audit_level` tag and `tenant_required` flag. small example: ```json
{"event_type":"access.granted","timestamp":"...","actor":{"id":"u123"},"resource":{"id":"r1"},"audit_level":"mandatory","tenant_required":true}
```
kevin (infra): index cost note: if we add high-cardinality fields like full resource.path to hot index, cost goes up. propose mapping: keep `resource.path` in cold index or as keyword limited to 512 chars and use doc_value=false for large text.
sasha (eng-sre): rollout plan (canary -> region -> global):
- canary 5% traffic with sampling on non-mandatory events
- enable DEK cache and measure kms.calls/sec drop
- enable CB with thresholds: queue_len>250k OR kms_429>5% for 2m -> trigger slowpath
- verify no missing mandatory events in the canary
metrics: ingress_r/s, queue_depth, kms_429, processed_mandatory_ratio, downstream_ack_lag

maria (sec-eng): proposed circuit-breaker config (for proxy):
```yaml
circuit_breaker:
  enabled: true
  queue_threshold: 250000
  kms_429_threshold_pct: 5
  window: 120s
  action: return_429_to_producer
  sample_rate_when_tripped: 0.02 # keep 2% of non-mandatory events
```
ryan (product-sec): need to add validation hooks so customer-facing audit API returns a compatibility error if schema is missing required fields. tiny validation at ingestion to drop malformed event but route to quarantine bucket + alert.
kevin (infra): cost estimate: if we don't change anything, extra indexing + KMS calls ~ $12k/month for staging scale X. with DEK cache + sampling, overhead is ~ $1.5k/mo. rough numbers but useful to justify.
sasha (eng-sre): runbook actions for oncall:
- step 0: enable sampling feature-flag
- step 1: enable DEK cache (hotfix)
- step 2: enable CB at 5% canary
- step 3: monitor metrics above, rollback flag if mandatory_ratio < 99.9%
- step 4: open follow-up: index mapping change, cold-store pipeline for verbose fields

maria (sec-eng): I'll open a PR with schema changes + runbook and assign tasks: @kevin for infra DEK cache, @sasha for CB + metrics dashboard, @ryan for customer validation hooks.
kevin (infra): will start DEK cache PR today. quick note: need KMS keypolicy update so DEK grants can be cached by instance role, security review needed.
ryan (product-sec): I'll draft the customer communication template in case customers see gaps during migration. include sample verification query and how to request full replay.
sasha (eng-sre): I'll add alerts to pager on kms_429>3% sustained and processed_mandatory_ratio<99.9%. also will test CB in staging now.
maria (sec-eng): thanks. action items captured. we should plan a postmortem if we hit >1h degradation. I'll tag this thread in the runbook. :thumbsup:
